_comment: Configuration reference. Source of truth: planning/config.py. All optional, safe defaults. Env vars are read by Config.from_env.

constants._note: Clients cap a single tools/call at ~60s (DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MSEC; hardcoded in Claude Desktop) and DISCARD the result on overrun, breaking the conversation. Progress heartbeats are not a fix: resetTimeoutOnProgress is a client-passed option that defaulted to false in older SDKs and cannot be set or read by a server. So the wait is chunked into CALL_BUDGET_SEC slices. NO_PROGRESS_WAIT_CEILING_SEC now applies only to the legacy trust_heartbeat mode.

settings.purpose: Where plan_state.json, approval.json, audit.jsonl, and lock files live. Resolved from planning/config.py, NOT the CWD.
Retention cap; oldest terminal plans pruned beyond this. Never prunes an active plan.
Oversized task lists are truncated, not rejected.
TEST ONLY. Bypasses the HITL gate; logs a loud warning on every call.
Hold the approval tool call open until a human decides (physical loop pause). false = advisory-only.
Loopback-only approval page port. Only the base port is bound; peers share it.
TOTAL seconds the human may take, accumulated across chunked tool calls and measured from when the request first appeared (survives a server restart).
Ceiling on ONE tools/call. Must stay under the client's request timeout (~60s) or the client drops the result. Shrinks automatically below any cancellation actually observed (state/client_caps.json).

chunked: slice the wait into call_budget pieces and have the model call straight back (conversation resumes without user input). return: publish and return at once (user must send a chat message after deciding). trust_heartbeat: pre-1.14 single long call, only where progress resets are measured to work.
Auto-open the approval page on startup (best-effort). Since 1.14.0 a request never opens a second window: once only, and not at all while a tab has polled within 10s.
Seconds an approval stays valid; an idle-longer plan's approval is revoked (re-approval required).
Cap on concurrently active (non-terminal) plans; beyond it new plans are refused with PLAN_AMBIGUOUS.
The last DONE moves the plan to AWAITING_COMPLETION and a human must approve a per-task completion report before COMPLETED. false = complete immediately (pre-1.9.0).
Minimum normalized length of result_log evidence for DONE. Bare success phrases and task-title echoes are rejected regardless of length.
SSE bind address when --transport sse. Loopback only; other addresses are refused in code. CLI --host wins.
SSE transport port. CLI --port wins; there is deliberately no argparse default so the flag's absence cannot override the env var.
